scenes.text: Here is the pick and roll, the most common two-player action in basketball.
First, the big sets a screen right next to the ball handler's defender.
The ball handler dribbles tight off the screen, so the defender gets caught behind it.
When the defense commits to the ball, the screener rolls hard toward the rim and gets the pass.
The screener catches in stride and finishes at the basket.

steps.label: Set the screen
steps.headline: The big sets a *solid screen*
steps.tip: 5 plants both feet beside the ball handler's defender and stays still.

steps.label: Use the screen
steps.headline: Drive *off the shoulder*
steps.tip: 1 dribbles tight past the screen so X1 is caught behind it.

steps.label: Roll to the rim
steps.headline: The screener *rolls* to the rim
steps.tip: With two defenders on the ball, 5 is open: roll hard and show a target.

steps.label: Finish
steps.headline: Catch and *finish* at the rim
steps.tip: Catch in stride, one dribble, and lay it in.
